text: Project management is an interdisciplinary field that combines engineering technology and management science. Its core lies in addressing the issue of "how to efficiently and orderly transform engineering projects from drawings into reality". It focuses on the planning, organization, coordination, and control of the entire project life cycle (from planning, design, construction to operation and maintenance), requiring not only an understanding of technical details but also proficiency in management methods and tools. Ultimately, it aims to achieve a balance among the three goals of "quality, schedule, and cost", while also taking into account safety, environmental protection, and social responsibility.
